job.value: fill in the listing and choose delivery options before listing

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Listing 1' with photos, 'Category', 'Listing title' and 'Condition' fields reads as a sell form.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The full-width teal 'List it' is pinned and is the strongest element.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'List it', 'Add' and the toggles are clear, but 'Post all' beside a single listing and the unlabelled '•••' don't say what they do.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: Most fields are plain, but 'Buy' button and 'Fixed price' rely on helper text and 'Carousell Official Delivery' is only explained in a banner.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Category, title, condition, price and deal methods are all things the seller knows about their own item.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Delivery sits in a collapsible 'Delivery method and payment' section, but price-guidance bars and 'See prices similar items were sold for' are shown to everyone in full.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: The fields fit listing, but the screen shows a second '9:41' status row under the real status bar.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Field labels and toggles carry the form; helper text is one line each.
